# Great AI Race

> An independent, sourced leaderboard that ranks nine AI labs as racers on a tall neon race track. Six lanes (Money, Reach, Brains, Muscle, Momentum, Openness) are each normalized 0–100 across the labs and averaged into a composite. Data as of Nov 17, 2026; daily update target. Not affiliated with any lab. Not investment advice and not a betting product.

## Standings (equal weights, as of Nov 17, 2026)
1. OpenAI — composite 80.5 (https://www.greatairace.com/racers/openai/)
2. Google DeepMind — composite 73.9 (https://www.greatairace.com/racers/google-deepmind/)
3. Meta — composite 65.7 (https://www.greatairace.com/racers/meta/)
4. Anthropic — composite 65.2 (https://www.greatairace.com/racers/anthropic/)
5. xAI — composite 55.3 (https://www.greatairace.com/racers/xai/)
6. Alibaba Qwen — composite 47.6 (https://www.greatairace.com/racers/alibaba-qwen/)
7. DeepSeek — composite 42.3 (https://www.greatairace.com/racers/deepseek/)
8. Moonshot Kimi — composite 38.8 (https://www.greatairace.com/racers/moonshot/)
9. Mistral — composite 27.4 (https://www.greatairace.com/racers/mistral/)
Exhibition (not ranked, dead last for now): Big AI Brain — a from-scratch, crowd-fed AI with no outside LLM (https://www.greatairace.com/racers/big-ai-brain/)

## Data for agents
- [Race data JSON](https://www.greatairace.com/data/race.json): every value with its source URL, as-of date and note; normalized lane scores; composite and rank. `value: null` means not disclosed (never estimated). Check `meta.as_of` for freshness.
- [Data documentation](https://www.greatairace.com/data/): field guide for race.json
- Update cadence: daily target. A figure that cannot be re-verified keeps its last good value and date, with a note.
- Reuse: allowed with credit "Great AI Race (greatairace.com)" and a link.

## Key pages
- [Race track and metrics key](https://www.greatairace.com/): live standings, weight sliders, FAQ
- [All racers](https://www.greatairace.com/racers/): one fact card per lab
- [Methodology](https://www.greatairace.com/methodology/): formulas, missing-data rule, source conflicts
- [Blog](https://www.greatairace.com/blog/): sourced analysis

## Articles
- [AI lab IPOs explained: who is public and who is going public](https://www.greatairace.com/blog/ai-lab-ipos-explained/): Some AI labs trade on a stock exchange, some sit inside public giants, and some are still private. A sourced map of who is where in November 2026.
- [The AI compute race: who has the most chips and data centers?](https://www.greatairace.com/blog/ai-compute-race-gpus-data-centers/): Chips owned, megawatts online and dollars committed tell three different stories. Here is who leads each one, with Epoch AI data.
- [Chinese AI labs vs US labs in 2026: where each side leads](https://www.greatairace.com/blog/chinese-ai-labs-vs-us-labs-2026/): US labs lead on top benchmark scores, compute and money. Chinese labs lead open-model usage. How big is the gap? It depends on the yardstick.
- [Who is winning the AI race in 2026?](https://www.greatairace.com/blog/who-is-winning-the-ai-race-2026/): OpenAI leads the composite, but the lead depends on what you count. A lane-by-lane look at the nine labs, with every number sourced.
- [OpenAI vs Google DeepMind vs Anthropic: how they compare](https://www.greatairace.com/blog/openai-vs-google-deepmind-vs-anthropic/): Three frontier labs, six lanes, one table. Where each leads, where each trails, and why the answer depends on what you value.
- [The biggest AI labs by valuation in November 2026](https://www.greatairace.com/blog/biggest-ai-labs-by-valuation/): From Alphabet's trillions to Mistral's billions: valuations and market caps for the nine racers, with dates and caveats.
- [Open-weight vs closed AI models, explained](https://www.greatairace.com/blog/open-weight-vs-closed-ai-models/): What "open weights" really means, how licenses differ, and which of the nine racers release models anyone can download.

## Notes
- Brains uses Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5 (launched ~Oct 28 2026; v5.0.1 revision noted Nov 9 2026); v5 scores are not comparable to older versions.
- Money uses parent-company market caps for Google DeepMind (Alphabet), Meta, Alibaba Qwen and xAI (SpaceX); AI is not broken out.
- Related: AI hackathons ranked by prize per entrant at https://hackathontracker.com/
